method: headless managed Chromium; 34 synthetic agents and 200 messages; 20 subsequent single-message renders; timings via performance.now()
changes: update sender/recipient/reply/edited fields only on newly created cards
build an agent id→name map once per render instead of scanning state.agents per message
append all new cards in one DOM mutation
note: Existing cards are immutable for these fields: edits/deletes bump messageRevision and force a full reload. Agent renaming is not supported. Initial 200-card paint remains ~45 ms in headless Chromium.

autoforge.scope: adapter-reported build/test only; no runtime or deployment claim
limitations: operator-owned adapters run outside a sandbox
test_pass covers the targeted acceptance subset; the full node --test suite was run separately
browser behavior was verified manually in headless Chromium; the node suite does not execute public/app.js.
